title: Patroni: live PG + etcd + HAProxy status
description: Runs `nexus status postgres`: 3 Patroni PG nodes (1 leader/primary + 2 replica) + 3 etcd (dcs) + 2 HAProxy (router; the VIP holder is router*).

observe.what: exactly 1 pg node role=primary (Patroni Leader) + 2 replica (streaming); 3 etcd=dcs; 2 haproxy=router, the keepalived MASTER shown router*; leader=<pg leader>

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.GetStatusAsync parses patronictl list --format json for PG roles + probes etcd/haproxy liveness + the VIP holder.
